name: elsa-data-backend
description: The backend that serves HTML/API for Elsa Data

author.name: University of Melbourne Centre for Cancer Research

scripts.//watch:*: Watch run the dev application with a variety of configurations
scripts.watch:bare: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.bare --watch src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.watch:local: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.local --watch src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.watch:mac: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.mac --watch src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.watch:linux: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.linux --watch src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.watch:aws: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.aws --watch src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.//dev:*: Plain run the dev application with a variety of configurations
scripts.dev:bare: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.bare src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.dev:local: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.local src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.dev:mac: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.mac src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.dev:linux: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.linux src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.dev:aws: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.aws src/entrypoint.ts web-server-with-scenario 1
scripts.//sync: For scenarios where data is not already loaded, we can trigger the sync of any configured dataset
scripts.dev:config: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local tsx -r dotenv/config src/entrypoint.ts config
scripts.//typecheck: Use the Typescript compiler for a compile of the complete src/test/types (no code generated or run)
scripts.//gelmigration: Creates a migration script based on the difference between the current db and schema file
scripts.//edgemigrate: Brings the current db up to date
scripts.//geltypes: Generates Typescript classes that match the schema of the *current* project EdgeDb
scripts.geltypes: generate queries --file && generate edgeql-js --force-overwrite  && generate interfaces
scripts.//testsetup:*: Ways to put the database in various test states for ad-hoc/manual work
scripts.testsetup:blank: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.bare src/entrypoint.ts 'db-blank'
scripts.testsetup:scenario1: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.bare src/entrypoint.ts 'db-blank ; add-scenario 1'
scripts.testsetup:sync10g: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.bare src/entrypoint.ts 'sync-datasets urn:fdc:umccr.org:2022:dataset/10g'
scripts.testsetup:sync10f: bunx cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun run --env-file ./.env.bare src/entrypoint.ts 'sync-datasets urn:fdc:umccr.org:2022:dataset/10f'
scripts.//test:*: Run test suites by type of test
